items.statement: The submission constructs the three named neutral Fe(II) complexes with both intended HS and LS states and preserves donor/atom identity.
items.expected: C1, C2 and C3 each have an explicitly identified HS multiplicity-5 and LS multiplicity-1 calculation with intact LPh-TDA/pseudohalide connectivity.

items.statement: The submitted state energies are supported by optimization and state-validation diagnostics plus explicit coverage/stopping information.
items.expected: Stationarity or bounded failure, spin diagnostics, method/unit/sign audit, starts and rejected candidates are reported for every named complex.

items.statement: The calculation provides supported isolated electronic HS-minus-LS gaps for each fixed complex.
items.expected: Per-state energies, spin/identity evidence, correct units and the E_HS minus E_LS sign convention support each reported gap. Compare defensible methods on their own evidence; no exact source value is compulsory across methods.

items.statement: The series follows the reported relative ligand-field trend.
items.expected: Evaluate whether the validated within-method gaps support the source trend C3 > C2 > C1 or a scientifically supported alternative; agreement is not compulsory across freely chosen methods.
